title: The OpenSSL library bundled with the Illumio VEN for Windows is affected by an uncontrolled search… (CVE-2026-114032)
description: The OpenSSL library included with the Illumio VEN for Windows contains an uncontrolled search path vulnerability (CWE-427). This flaw allows a low-privileged, authenticated local attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.8. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
